dataset_id: candidate-epivr (Kini et al. 2019 virtual resection cohort; IEEG.org)
repository_url: https://github.com/ieeg-portal/EpiVR (code only); data reported on https://www.ieeg.org
reported_subject_count_source: Abstract (PMC6885672): 'a retrospective cohort of 28 patients'; Table 1: 17 good (Engel I/ILAE 1-2), 11 poor
data_access: to_verify: paper's Data availability says imaging, seizure annotations and ECoG are public via IEEG.org (registration-based portal); IEEG.org page could not be rendered by fetch tool. GitHub repo verified to contain code only.
licence: Code: MIT (GitHub API). Data: to_verify (IEEG.org terms)
approx_total_size_basis: GitHub repo ~20.7 MB (API 'size' 20731 KB), 79 tree entries, no patient recordings; data size on IEEG.org unknown
verified_modalities: to_verify (repo tree inspected: code, docs/templates, tiny test NIfTI/mat fixtures only)
intervention_linkage: reported: resected electrodes determined by 'a quantitative pipeline using pre- and post-surgical imaging' plus surgical-conference cartoon maps (Results/Methods, PMC6885672); not verified in files
follow_up_definition: reported: outcome 'measured at a minimum of 1 year after surgery' from last clinician follow-up (Methods, 'Surgical outcome')
eligibility: Superseded in practice by ds004100 (same HUP family, larger, public CC0 BIDS with resect tags). Use only if IEEG.org adds imaging/segmentations absent from ds004100.
cohort_overlap: Subset of fam-hup-penn; ds004100 README states a subset of its data was featured in Kini & Bernabei 2019; HUP080 (named in Kini 2019 Fig. 4 discussion) is in ds004100. HUP073 (also named) is not in ds004100.
